  "pros": [
    "Excellent for securely managing passwords across devices",
    "Streamlines team access to shared credentials",
    "Intuitive interface for daily use"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Pricing can feel high for a small business",
    "Occasional learning curve for advanced team features",
    "Support response times could be improved"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This SAP Basis Consultant found 1Password to be a highly functional tool for managing and securing passwords for both personal use across multiple devices and for small team collaboration. The product effectively met the core need of centralizing credentials, although the cost for a small business was a minor concern. While generally easy to use, some advanced configurations required a bit of a learning curve, and the customer support experience was adequate but not exceptional."
